evidence_quotes.call_type_determination: Nicole said 'Usually for office moves we do a virtual walkthrough it's like a video call on your preferred time and date. So we can identify how many movers and how many trucks you will be needing' — this is the walkthrough branch routing from step 1
evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Nicole asked 'Hi, this is Nicole from Einstein Levin, how may I help you?' and Linda volunteered 'Hi, my name is Linda'. Nicole used Linda's name at the end: 'Take care and you have a great day Linda.'
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Nicole moved straight into logistics and inventory after offering the walkthrough option.
evidence_quotes.logistics_gathered: Linda provided: items needing disassembly (2, 3 piece desks), quantity (7 desks), same-building move (second to third floor), elevator availability, buffet cabinet details, and prep notes (monitors/items removed beforehand, nothing packed inside furniture)
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Not asked. Office environment with furniture and desks, not residential packing scenario.
evidence_quotes.promises_not_delivered: No mention of On-Time Guarantee or No Worries Damage Coverage. No permission lead-in asking before sharing how Einstein works.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_and_no_deposit_mentioned: Nicole said 'there's no deposit required if you have to reschedule or cancel no fees for that either' — but this came during booking confirmation, not as part of an ask for the business. The call was routed to walkthrough before the ask step was reached.

top_strength: Nicole successfully gathered detailed logistics (disassembly needs, furniture count, floor layout, elevator access, customer prep level) and correctly identified this as an office move requiring a virtual walkthrough before quoting, keeping the customer engaged throughout the inventory upload and photo review process.
coaching_note: On future walkthrough-router calls, complete step 2 (the two-concerns question) and step 3 (both promises with permission lead-in and closing ask) before routing to the walkthrough, since the v4 card places both those steps before probing and they are now graded on walkthrough calls rather than auto-credited.
